caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular tray with rounded corners positioned against a muted grayish-green background. The tray itself is a warm, reddish-brown color and features a decorative yellow design inside, consisting of two wavy lines—one at the top and one at the bottom—and a stylized, branching leaf motif across the center. The edge of the tray is outlined with a patterned border. The tray is resting on a horizontal flat brown surface resembling a tabletop or shelf. Above the tray, the words "BREAD TRAY EARLY 19th CENTURY" are written in large, capitalized black letters.
title: Bread Tray
